method: Rules Test API projects.test, one ruleset per probe, from the 2026-11-03 Firestore rules engine defect hunt (captures c2 and c5). A probe production refused lists the error the API returned; one that compiles lists each get case with its decision. The two source-size probes store their source as a template whose placeholder stands for the comment body, the character repeated that many times; sourceBytes and sourceSha256 are of the source as sent.
